pages.headline: 6' Big chance - Real Madrid
pages.caption: Attempt missed. Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) right footed shot from outside the box is high and wide to the right.

pages.headline: 12' Big chance - Barcelona
pages.caption: Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) hits the crossbar with a header from the centre of the box.

pages.headline: 18' GOAL - Real Madrid 1-0 Barcelona
pages.caption: Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the far corner. Assisted by Kylian Mbappe with a through ball. Real Madrid 1-0 Barcelona.
pages.explanation: Goal at 18' made it Real Madrid 1-0 Barcelona.

pages.headline: 29' Big chance - Barcelona
pages.caption: Attempt blocked. Raphinha (Barcelona) left footed shot from the centre of the box is blocked.

pages.headline: 41' Big chance - Barcelona
pages.caption: Attempt missed. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) right footed shot from the right side of the box is close, but misses to the right.

pages.headline: 55' GOAL - Real Madrid 2-0 Barcelona
pages.caption: Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the centre of the box. Assisted by Kylian Mbappe. Real Madrid 2-0 Barcelona.
pages.explanation: Goal at 55' made it Real Madrid 2-0 Barcelona.

pages.headline: 63' Big chance - Barcelona
pages.caption: Attempt saved. Raphinha (Barcelona) right footed shot from outside the box is saved in the bottom left corner.

pages.headline: 77' GOAL - Real Madrid 2-1 Barcelona
pages.caption: Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) header from the centre of the box. Assisted by Lamine Yamal with a cross. Real Madrid 2-1 Barcelona.
pages.explanation: Goal at 77' made it Real Madrid 2-1 Barcelona.

pages.headline: 90' GOAL - Real Madrid 3-1 Barcelona
pages.caption: Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) left footed shot to the bottom right corner after a fast break. Assisted by Jude Bellingham. Real Madrid 3-1 Barcelona.
pages.explanation: Goal at 90' made it Real Madrid 3-1 Barcelona.
